messages.author: f9a6ef92236e92f8
messages.subject: uncertainty dsm
parts:
Dear list,

I am trying to use the code provided by Miller and colleagues but I am unable to use the function dsm.var.prop and when I use dsm.var.gam, instead of having also the uncertainty of the dsm as in the file below, I obtain only the confidence intervals.
What am I doing wrong?

Thanks for your inputs!




mod1.varprop <- dsm.var.prop(bp_model_global, pred.data = preddata.varprop,off.set = offset.varprop)
Error in dsm_varprop(dsm.obj, pred.data[[1]]) : 
  varprop doesn't work when there are no covariates in the detection function

> preddata.varprop <- split(preddata, 1:nrow(preddata))
> offset.varprop <- as.list(rep(off.set, nrow(preddata)))
> mod1.varprop <- dsm.var.gam(bp_model_global, pred.data = preddata.varprop,off.set = offset.varprop)
> summary(mod1.varprop)
Summary of uncertainty in a density surface model calculated
 analytically for GAM, with delta method

Approximate asymptotic confidence interval:
    2.5%     Mean    97.5% 
14.62733 20.89312 29.84294 
(Using log-Normal approximation)

Point estimate                 : 20.89312 
CV of detection function       : 0.1411717 
CV from GAM                    : 0.1171 
Total standard error           : 3.832231 
Total coefficient of variation : 0.1834 


Best,
Cristiane

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] uncertainty dsm
parts:
Hi Cristiane,

Note sure what you mean here by "instead of having also the uncertainty
of the dsm", the code you supply looks correct to me. The number
reported below as "Total coefficient of variation" (0.1834) is the
uncertainty of the dsm. Unfortunately I can't see what the image is you
put into your message. If you were looking for a plot, then calling
plot(mod1.varprop) should give you the plot of the CV in space, if
that's useful? Depending on your model setup, you may need to tell the
plot function what your spatial covariates are (see the documentation at
?plot.dsm.var)

Hope that helps!

cheers,
--dave

messages.author: f9a6ef92236e92f8
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] uncertainty dsm
parts:
Dear Dave,

Thanks for your reply!

It worked!

mod1.varprop <- dsm.var.gam(ba_model_global, pred.data = preddata.varprop,off.set = offset.varprop)
summary(mod1.varprop)

hist(mod1.varprop$pred.var,100)

cv_ba <- cbind(grille_sp, mod1.varprop$pred.var)

carte_p<- ggplot()+geom_sf(data=SSL)
carte_p <- carte_p+geom_sf(data=cv_ba, aes(fill = cv_ba$mod1.varprop.pred.var))+scale_fill_gradientn(colors=wes_palette("Zissou1"),name="Minke whale (ind/km2)")
carte_p <- carte_p+geom_sf(data=pmssl,fill=NA,size=1.3,color="black")+coord_sf(crs=4326,xlim = st_coordinates(bbox)[c(1,2),1], ylim = st_coordinates(bbox)[c(2,3),2])
carte_p
